The ``filename`` attribute and :meth:`!__init__` constructor argument were
      removed.  They have been available using the name ``source`` since 3.2.


.. exception:: MultilineContinuationError

   Exception raised when a continuation line follows an option that has
   no value.  A continuation line, as determined by the parser, is a
   non-blank, non-comment line whose first non-whitespace character is
   indented further than the first non-whitespace character of the line
   introducing the option.  This condition can only arise when the
   parser was created with the ``allow_no_value`` parameter set to
   ``True``.  Subclass of :exc:`ParsingError`.

   Instances provide the following attributes:

   ``source``
      The name of the file or string source being parsed.

   ``lineno``
      The one-based line number of the offending continuation line.

   ``line``
      The exact content of the offending continuation line.


.. rubric:: Footnotes

.. [1] Config parsers allow for heavy customization.  If you are interested in
       changing the behaviour outlined by the footnote reference, consult the
       `Customizing Parser Behaviour`_ section.
